Magic Cycles Shop Ride

Boone, NC · Road

Magic Cycles Shop Ride is a road group ride in Boone, NC. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:30 pm from Magic Cycles.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Magic Cycles Shop Ride group ride

Wednesday shop ride in the High Country, listed on the Boone Area Cyclists ride page with a Strava route. Boone rides go out most weekday evenings at 5:30 from mid-March through September; this is the shop-hosted one.
